ActorTalk: Simon, you're being way too modest again. But Sica, if you ask me, the real trick is learning to hide your weaknesses.
Oh, since it's rare to have this chance, I was asking Simon and Harley Jo to share some insights from their own experience.
Like I said, there's not much to tell. When I look back, it was really just about giving it everything and trying not to throw up...
But if you want to hear how lively my squad is, now that I could talk about all day.
Let's save the stories for another time. And Sica, if you want insight based on our experience... Hey, 【kuroname】, how about you share something too?
Like some surefire winning method of yours, for example.
Huh?
Believe... I see. Believe in yourself, believe in your comrades, believe we'll never lose. I understand now, 【kuroname】!
Wait, what exactly do you think you understood?
Haha...
Nice subject change. For what it's worth, the speech was solid, not that you've ever struggled in that department.
Yeah, a few of my classmates were really moved. They said they want you to be their role model.
Only downside is the F.O.S. auditorium isn't big enough. More people should've heard it.
You wanted our opinion, and now you're getting shy?
Seriously though, it was great. If I ever need to do a pep talk, I'll borrow some of your lines.
Ah, that's a good point. This can also be noted down as combat experience.
What are you guys talking about?
So, what do you guys think of my speech?
To believe.
...You're giving me too much credit.
